name: Masked Heading
description: Large heading whose letters act as a mask over an image or looping video, with pointer parallax, slow drift, optional spotlight and outline, and several letter reveal animations.
contents: Heading element (configurable tag) with text split into words and letters
Image or video layer clipped to the letter shapes through an SVG clipPath
Optional color tint layer, spotlight layer and letter outline
behavior: Media is visible only inside the letter shapes and slowly drifts in a sine path
Pointer movement shifts the media in the opposite direction (parallax)
Hover zooms the media by hoverZoom on non-touch pointers
Optional spotlight dims and desaturates the media except around a soft circle that wanders on its own and follows the pointer on hover
Reveal animation plays on view, on hover, or on mount depending on trigger
Font size scales with container width, clamped between 20px and 200px
Animation loop pauses when offscreen and stops entirely under prefers-reduced-motion, which also pauses video and skips reveals
editableByProps: Heading text, HTML tag, alignment, weight, tracking, line height and size ratio
Image or video source, poster, fill scale, brightness, saturation, grayscale and tint
Parallax strength, drift amount, hover zoom
Spotlight on or off and its radius
Outline on or off, color and width
Reveal style, duration, stagger and trigger

needsCodeEdit.change: Change spotlight darkness or falloff curve
needsCodeEdit.where: SPOT_MASK constant and the opacity-55 span in the spotlight block
frame function, the Math.sin and Math.cos lines using clock
play function inside the reveal useIsomorphicLayoutEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Add alt text for the image
needsCodeEdit.where: img element with alt empty string

fixed: Requires a media src, with the default empty src only a faint tinted letter fill shows
Extra props are spread onto the heading element
Font family is inherited from the page, so set it through className or style
Root is a full-width heading element with no viewport frame, so media size follows the heading box and the font size
Letter shapes depend on JS text measurement with Range and SVG text, so layout recalculates on resize and font load
Video is always muted, looping, autoplaying and inline
Image alt text is hardcoded empty, the layer is decorative
Touch pointers do not trigger hover zoom or spotlight following
Text is split by whitespace, so long headings wrap at word boundaries and very narrow containers scale text down to a 20px minimum

options.look: Letters slide up into place word by word with a strong ease-out
options.useWhen: Hero headline that should enter confidently as the visitor scrolls to it

options.look: Letters pop from zero size one after another
options.useWhen: Playful brand or event landing headline

options.look: Heading fades in from a heavy blur while letters settle sideways
options.useWhen: Cinematic film or travel intro that should feel like coming into focus

options.look: Heading is uncovered left to right
options.useWhen: Section title in a portfolio or case study that should read like a curtain opening

options.look: Heading fades in while shrinking slightly from 108 percent
options.useWhen: Subtle intro for a calm editorial or luxury page

options.look: No animation, heading is shown immediately
options.useWhen: Headings that repeat often on a page or for users who need no motion
